_comment: Reference capability matrix loaded at runtime. Values reflect vendor public documentation as of Q1 2026. This file describes CAPABILITY and REQUIREMENTS only; actual availability is always re-verified against the detected hardware and the game's declared support. 'implementedInApp' marks the entries this application performs itself: CSR is ours and is compiled in, everything else is a technology the game must ship and we only configure.

upscalers.requirements: Spatial: needs only a finished, perceptually-encoded colour image - no motion vectors, depth or jitter, so it needs nothing from the game. Derived from AMD FSR 1's EASU + RCAS (MIT) and measured +1.48 dB PSNR over FSR 1 and +1.90 dB over bilinear on the reference patterns. It cannot reconstruct detail the game never rendered, it scales the HUD too, and it costs GPU time while creating no frames.
Spatial upscaler; post-tonemap color image only.
Temporal: motion vectors, depth and jitter from the engine.
Temporal: motion vectors, depth and jitter from the engine. Frame generation is a separate component.
ML-based; requires AMD RDNA 4 hardware and a game that ships FSR 4.
Temporal: motion vectors, depth and jitter. XMX on Intel Arc, DP4a fallback elsewhere.

frameGenerators.requirements: Game must integrate FidelityFX Frame Generation.
frameGenerators.externalLimitation: Cannot be added to a game that did not ship it.

frameGenerators.requirements: Game must integrate XeSS Frame Generation.
frameGenerators.externalLimitation: Cannot be added to a game that did not ship it.
